_comment_baseline: Baselines are deliberately neutral. These skills teach how to frame a problem, so a baseline prompt that names the frame ('advise on whether research is worth doing') hands the model the skill's main contribution and collapses the measured delta. Use a role prime only for skills that carry domain facts rather than framing.
